Environment types for 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer.

Note: This is for the scripts that would be run in-game, for scripts in plugins (the ones that would put the scripts that would use this into the Ore UI files), use [@ore-ui-customizer-api/plugin-env](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ore-ui-customizer-api/plugin-env) instead.

The following should also be installed when using this package:

-   [ore-ui-types](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ore-ui-types)
-   [@ore-ui-types/enums](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ore-ui-types/enums)
